d:
Indian roads are synonymous with traffic jams, impatient drivers and endless honking. But Aizawl, the capital of Mizoram, is challenging that stereotype with its remarkable traffic discipline, lane etiquette and no-honking culture.
Aizawl has had a no-honking policy since 2017, with motorists patiently following traffic rules, respecting stop lines and waiting their turn. Its unusually quiet roads caught the attention of industrialist Anand Mahindra, who praised the city's civic sense and suggested that its peaceful streets could even attract tourists.
